goal: Replace app icon and logo with the newly provided frosted glass artwork, removing the black background for transparent alpha across macOS and Android assets

steps.title: Extract mask and produce transparent PNG
steps.note: Extracted squircle matte and eliminated black background using flood-fill segmentation and un-premultiplied edge anti-aliasing. Produced 1024x1024 transparent RGBA image (/tmp/maclink_icon_clean.png) with zero black fringe on light backgrounds.

steps.title: Replace macOS brand and desktop icon assets
steps.note: Replaced assets/brand/icon-1024.png, icon-512.png, maclink-liquid-logo.png, generated MacLink.icns with iconutil, and refreshed all 9 desktop raw icons in desktop/app/src/icons_raw/ with the transparent frosted glass mark.

steps.title: Replace Android app logo and launcher icons
steps.note: Updated android/app/src/main/res/drawable/maclink_logo.png and all densities (mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi) for ic_launcher.png, ic_launcher_round.png, and ic_launcher_foreground.png with the new transparent frosted glass icon.

steps.title: Verify assets and unit tests
steps.note: Verified all 19 PNG assets for dimension accuracy, RGBA format, and transparent corner pixels. Ran maclink-core unit tests (113 passed) and maclink-protocol unit tests (62 passed) with 0 failures without executing full app builds.
